main_body: two-story half-timbered building with tiled roof
top_band: tiled roof surface seen from above (rows 0-43, warm red-brown and orange-gold tiles with highlight ridge at rows 2-3)
evidence: Rows 0-43 show the pitched tile roof surface seen from above with a distinct ridge highlight (rows 2-3) and lower eave border (row 43). Rows 44-49 form a deep eave shadow cast onto the upper plaster wall. Below, rows 44-106 show the two-story half-timbered south facade with recessed windows, awning, and inset door.

style.evidence: The candidate is directly from the Beodeul chipset (matching the exact roof tile pattern, chimney, plaster speckle, timber framing, and door of house-h101_0) with rich 6-step material ramps, dark material-toned outlines, and dense per-tile detail.
